description.value: Skobi is a Langley Township restaurant that uniquely pairs Korean-style tabletop BBQ — featuring a high-tech equalizer vent system for a clean, smoke-free atmosphere — with a full sushi menu developed from over 12 years of culinary experience. The kitchen uses Canada Prime beef (top 2% grade) and sources fresh ingredients for its sushi selections. Free customer parking with plate registration is available on-site.
